en.headline: Wang Fuk Court residents begin selecting replacement subsidised flats
en.dek: The first 35 households that accepted buy-back offers by the June deadline started choosing from about 4,400 units across 10 estates under the special sales arrangement on Tuesday.
body: Residents affected by the deadly fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po began selecting replacement subsidised flats on Tuesday under a special sales exercise linked to the government’s buy-back scheme.

The Housing Authority said the first batch of about 35 households that signed letters of acceptance by 30 June were given priority and started the selection process at its Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme sales office in Kwun Tong from 10am.

Under the long-term housing arrangements announced earlier, owners who sold their titles can use the compensation to buy on the open market or join the flat-for-flat arrangement covering Home Ownership Scheme, Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme and Hong Kong Housing Society projects. About 4,400 flats from 10 estates are available under the special exercise.

Some residents expressed satisfaction with the new homes on offer, while others called for stamp duty waivers to ease the financial burden of purchasing larger units. The government has earmarked funds to acquire the damaged flats following the November blaze that killed scores and displaced thousands.

zh.headline: 宏福苑特設銷售計劃今起揀樓 首批約35戶優先選購
zh.dek: 首批於6月30日前簽署接納書的約35戶業主，周二起於觀塘綠置居銷售小組辦事處開始揀選約4400個資助房屋單位。
body: 受大埔宏福苑大火影響的業主，周二開始在特設銷售計劃下揀選重置的資助房屋單位。
房屋委員會表示，首批約35戶於6月30日前簽署接納書的業主獲優先安排，上午10時起陸續進入觀塘的綠置居銷售小組辦事處進行選樓。
根據早前公布的長遠房屋安排，出售業權的業主可用現金補償在私人市場購樓，或參與「以樓換樓」安排，涵蓋居屋、綠置居及房協項目。特設銷售計劃提供約4400個來自10個屋苑的單位供選擇。
部分業主對新單位表示滿意，亦有人呼籲當局豁免印花稅，以減輕選購較大單位的財政壓力。政府早前已預留資金收購受去年11月火災影響的單位，該火造成多人死亡及數千人流離失所。
